description: Every non-procedural runtime file under assets/models, assets/textures and assets/materials. Each entry points to a provenance record by id. The asset validator fails when a runtime file has no entry.

assets.notes: Parametric PBR presets derived from the style guide palette (style.md section 3); their textures are procedural surfaces generated in code (src/assets/include/rv/assets/surface_textures.hpp), no image files. Since I6 step 4 also the dark shells of cases and boxes standing on their side (MAT_Case_Jewel_Smoke, MAT_Case_Keep_Black, MAT_Case_Plastic_Dark, MAT_Cardboard_BigBox), original presets; since I6 step 6 the arcade cabinets' laminate, paints, lit mouldings and marquees and their screens (MAT_Cabinet_*, MAT_Molding_*, MAT_Marquee_*, MAT_Screen_Off, MAT_Screen_Idle, MAT_Screen_Arcade) and the handhelds' teal plastic (MAT_Plastic_Teal), original presets; since I5 step 3's review the secondary TV's charcoal plastic (MAT_Plastic_Charcoal), an original preset.

UI sans for the product screens (style.md section 17.3), loaded by rv::ui::UiSystem; since I3 step 5 also rasterized with stb_truetype for the generated collection labels' system name and year (rv::assets::FontFace, ADR-0011 section 5), loaded only when its SHA-256 matches this entry; the rasterized textures are derived data, never distributed as a font. Upstream fonts/ttf file, unmodified.

Bold weight of the UI sans; since I3 step 5 also rasterized with stb_truetype for the titles on the collection's spines and generated front labels (rv::assets::FontFace, ADR-0011 section 5), loaded only when its SHA-256 matches this entry; the rasterized textures are derived data, never distributed as a font. Upstream fonts/ttf file, unmodified.
